“Trump has used his office to enrich himself like no other president,” Kelly wrote.
The Arizona senator emphasized that the country’s legal system should apply to everyone, regardless of their position or political influence.
“We live in a country of laws,” Kelly said, adding that Trump and anyone else who abuses their position for personal gain “need to be held accountable.”
